ms.promise: · Set up API development environment, develop API, perform API unit testing, configure web3 development environment, develop UI and admin
ms.criteria:
· The application must be able to request and obtain the user's credentials. The application should display a message to the user requesting their consent to access their credentials.
The app must be able to connect to a wallet, the wallet must be available, and the app must be able to connect to the wallet when selected. The application must allow the user to sign transactions using their wallet. The application must display an interface that allows the user to review the details of the transaction before signing it.
The application should display relevant information about signed transaction

ms.promise: · · Integrate web3 portal with API, integrate web3 portal with smart contracts and NFT, integrate notification system with web3 portal and API
ms.criteria:
· The acceptance criteria are the following:
The API must be able to provide the web3 portal with the necessary data to display the information correctly and up-to-date.
The web3 portal must consume the API data efficiently, without affecting the performance of the application.
The web3 portal must be able to interact with smart contracts deployed on the blockchain.
The web3 portal should allow users to transact with NFTs, such as buying, selling, and transferring.
The web3 portal must be able to send notifications to users about relevant events, such as the receipt of an NFT or the execution
ms.report:
